I read a week of posts in one of the bigger Los Cabos rental groups on Facebook. It's a one-week sample, but it says a lot.

120 rental posts turned out to be 75 actual listings. The rest were the same ones posted again. One 4-bedroom went up four times in two days.

38 of those 75 didn't say how long the lease was. Some gave the rent in dollars and in pesos, and the numbers didn't match.

That's the search right now. Los Cabos Rental is long-term rentals only, Cabo San Lucas to San José, in one place. Join the renter waitlist, link in bio.
